recommendation: Keep the commit. A broader review of stale ActivityDefinition mapping snippets may be useful later, but this reconciliation intentionally limits the source change to the FHIR-11609 bodySite path.
issue_request: FHIR-11609 was Published/Persuasive and asked that ActivityDefinition support bodySite for non-medication activities, specifically ProcedureRequest; the approved resolution was to add bodySite to support ProcedureRequest.
initial_application: SVN #10174, represented in git as a0306a202b, added ActivityDefinition.bodySite to the historical spreadsheet source. Later source refactors preserved ActivityDefinition.bodySite in the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: ProcedureRequest has since been merged into ServiceRequest. Later OO decisions, including FHIR-50355 and FHIR-53203, moved ServiceRequest target-site representation away from bodySite toward bodyStructure as CodeableReference(BodyStructure), and current ServiceRequest source no longer has a bodySite element.
reconciliation: Kept ActivityDefinition.bodySite, corrected its comment from ServiceRequest.type to ServiceRequest.code, and changed the active ServiceRequest ActivityDefinition mapping in both the .fhirmap file and notes snippet to populate ServiceRequest.bodyStructure.concept instead of the removed ServiceRequest.bodySite.
source_changes: source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml: changed ActivityDefinition.bodySite comment to reference ServiceRequest.code.
source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-notes.xml: updated the corresponding rendered ServiceRequest mapping snippet.

related_jiras.note: Clarified that ServiceRequest.bodyStructure is preferred over ServiceRequest.bodySite for target-site coding.
Applied the R6 OO bodyStructure-as-CodeableReference direction that explains why current ServiceRequest no longer has bodySite.
